name: Dental Cost Estimator – Free Dental Pricing Calculator
author: adprozz

sections.description: Dental Cost Estimator lets dental clinics display instant, on-page price estimates for common treatments to increase trust and drive enquiries. Configure treatments, pricing fields, and currency from a clean admin screen, then embed the estimator anywhere with a shortcode. The frontend is responsive, accessible, and optimized for mobile. Clinics can highlight key options (e.g., material, tooth type, arches), present a transparent range, and encourage patients to enquire after estimating.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure treatments and pricing under Dental Cost Estimator → Settings.
  4. Use the shortcode [dental_cost_estimator] to embed the estimator anywhere.
sections.faq:
How to add the estimator on a page?

Add the shortcode [dental_cost_estimator] to any page or post.

Why does it only show up to three treatments?

The free version supports enabling up to three treatments only. Upgrade to Pro to unlock all features and unlimited treatments.

Can I customize the styles?

Yes, the plugin includes scoped CSS, and you can override the styles in your theme or custom CSS.
